Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator introduced a flawed extraction method by using a naive regex (matching all numbers) on the transcription, without constraining matches to page references (e.g., numbers following “page/pages/p.” or expanding stated ranges). This caused non-page numbers (like 22, 32, 44, 333, 1197) to be included, leading to an incorrect final list.
